movedTail:
- name: Synthetic Reference Six browser acceptance
        run: |
          test -x "$CHROMIUM_PATH"
          npm run test:final-reference-browser
        env:
          FINAL_REFERENCE_ARTIFACTS: ${{ runner.temp }}/final-reference-browser
      - name: Isolated Business browser acceptance
        run: |
          test -x "$CHROMIUM_PATH"
          node scripts/test-business-browser.mjs
        env:
          BUSINESS_BROWSER_ARTIFACTS: ${{ runner.temp }}/business-browser
      - name: Source-package integrity and fail-closed CI recovery guards
        run: |
          python3 scripts/verify-partial16-source.py --check
          node --test tests/ci-gate-recovery/*.test.mjs
      - name: Conditional private source contracts and immutable browser acceptance
        run: |
          python3 scripts/verify-conditional-source.py
          node tests/conditional-authority-review/browser.mjs
        env:
          CONDITIONAL_EVIDENCE: ${{ runner.temp }}/conditional-source-contracts
      - name: Six captured-source contracts and immutable browser acceptance
        run: |
          python3 scripts/verify-remaining-six-source.py
          node tests/remaining-authority-review/browser.mjs
        env:
          REMAINING_SIX_EVIDENCE: ${{ runner.temp }}/remaining-six-source-contracts
      - name: Fetch immutable native Blueprint candidate source
        run: git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 50f307c67e3a5e5d289d2b83e2a285029151f866
      - name: Original Blueprint scope and exact runtime receipts
        run: |
          python3 scripts/reconcile-native-blueprint.py --check
          python3 tests/blueprint-reconciliation/native.test.py
          node --test tests/blueprint-reconciliation/*.test.mjs
      - name: Fetch immutable canonical evidence source
        run: git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 7eff39b23a52953c028852d50d5571211a3f8a44
      - name: Canonical ledger and analytical successor acceptance
        run: |
          node scripts/canonical-acceptance-evidence.mjs docs/canonical-acceptance --check
          node tests/canonical-acceptance-review/browser.mjs
        env:
          CANONICAL_EVIDENCE: ${{ runner.temp }}/canonical-acceptance
      - name: Declared-domain calculus source, replay and typed browser acceptance
        run: |
          python3 scripts/reconcile-canonical-calculus.py --check
          node --test tests/canonical-calculus-workbench/frozen-source.test.mjs
          node tests/canonical-calculus-workbench/browser.mjs
        env:
          CALCULUS_EVIDENCE: ${{ runner.temp }}/canonical-calculus
copiedPDFSetup:
- name: Require independent PDF reader and renderer
        run: |
          if ! command -v pdftotext >/dev/null || ! command -v pdffonts >/dev/null || ! command -v pdftoppm >/dev/null || ! command -v pdfinfo >/dev/null; then
            sudo apt-get update -qq
            sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends poppler-utils
          fi
          node scripts/assert-pdf-tools.mjs
